event.name: 2026 Rasuwa–Bhote Koshi flash flood
event.cause_status: A rock–ice/glacial collapse on the Nepal side of Langtang Lirung is the leading assessment. It generated a cross-border debris-flow/flood; causal and field details remain under review.
event.evidence_status: Post-event S1+S2 cube sealed and OLMoEarth Δz executed. The five-anchor mean did not separate from pre-event variability; a matched token-level review candidate remains at Rasuwagadhi.

incident_updates.title: Langtang Lirung rock–ice collapse
incident_updates.summary: USGS reclassified the initial earthquake-like signal as an M5.2-equivalent landslide/glacial-collapse signal at zero depth; the source is on the Nepal side of Langtang Lirung.

incident_updates.title: Second seismic landslide signal
incident_updates.summary: A second M4.2-equivalent signal followed roughly three hours later on 26 Aug. It is not evidence of a separate 27 Aug Tibet landslide.

incident_updates.title: Debris-dammed lake reported
incident_updates.summary: Authorities reported a new upstream barrier lake created in the aftermath of the collapse; its exact public coordinates remained unresolved.

incident_updates.title: Barrier lake draining
incident_updates.summary: Chinese authorities reported the lake was draining and its level had fallen, while monitoring for secondary hazards continued.
incident_updates.source: State Council of the People's Republic of China

points.name: Langtang Lirung collapse source
points.place: North flank of Langtang Lirung, Rasuwa, Nepal (satellite/seismic estimate)
points.source: USGS + China Geological Survey + satellite interpretation
points.story: The rock–ice collapse began on the Nepal side of Langtang Lirung. This red marker is the best public source-search estimate—not a surveyed release polygon. It is the event origin; A and B are downstream impact/checkpoint windows.
points.story_ko: 암반–빙하 붕괴는 네팔 영내 Langtang Lirung에서 시작했다. 이 빨간 점은 공개자료상 최선의 발원 수색점이며 현장 측량 방출 폴리곤은 아니다. 사건 원점은 여기이고 A·B는 하류 충격/검문소 창이다.

points.name: Barrier lake (reported)
points.place: Lhende Khola upstream corridor, Gyirong County, Tibet (provisional)
points.source: NDRRMA report + AP and Chinese government updates; exact coordinates unpublished
points.story: A reported debris-dammed lake formed during the aftermath. Its public footprint is unresolved, so this purple marker is an approximate search zone—not a second collapse origin or a simulated lake boundary.
points.story_ko: 여파 과정에서 토석에 막힌 호수가 생겼다고 보고됐다. 공개 footprint가 없어 보라색 점은 근사 수색구역일 뿐이며, 두 번째 붕괴 원점이나 시뮬레이션 호수 경계가 아니다.

points.name: Rasuwagadhi impact AOI
points.place: Pasang Lhamu Highway, Rasuwagadhi, Rasuwa, Nepal
points.source: user coordinate + OSM Nominatim reverse lookup; USGS event assessment
points.story: The principal before/after inspection window at the Nepal–China crossing. A is not the collapse origin: it is where the upstream cascade reached infrastructure and where the current satellite time series is centered.
points.story_ko: 네팔–중국 국경의 핵심 전후 비교창이다. A는 붕괴 원점이 아니라 상류 연쇄가 기반시설에 도달한 곳이며 현재 위성 시계열의 중심이다.

points.name: Gyirong border checkpoint
points.source: user coordinate + OSM Nominatim reverse lookup; USGS event assessment
points.story: The cross-border checkpoint beside the impact AOI. It anchors human-exposure review without treating every bright or dark satellite pixel as confirmed infrastructure damage.
points.story_ko: 충격 관찰창 옆의 국경 검문소다. 모든 밝고 어두운 픽셀을 피해로 단정하지 않으면서 사람·기반시설 노출을 검토하는 기준점이다.

points.name: Trishuli Bazar / Bidur reach
points.place: Trishuli Bazar reach, Bidur, Nuwakot, Nepal
points.source: USGS public event map; OSM river reach
points.story: A real downstream Sentinel-2 before/after window on MGRS tile 45RUL. The pair closes the visual chain from source to river response; it is strong observation evidence, not yet a damage label or part of the sealed five-anchor OLMo contract.
points.story_ko: MGRS 45RUL에서 회수한 실제 하류 Sentinel-2 전후 창이다. 발원에서 하천 반응까지 시각 사슬을 닫지만, 아직 피해 라벨도 봉인된 OLMo 5-anchor 계약의 일부도 아니다.

points.name: Galchhi reach-search endpoint
points.place: Trishuli corridor near Galchhi, Dhading, Nepal
points.source: USGS preliminary ~100 km travel assessment + OSM river trace
points.story: The mapped inspection corridor currently ends here, 73.7 river-km below Rasuwagadhi. USGS reports nearly 100 km of total travel from the source, but has not published a final terminal deposit polygon. G is the end of this trace—not proof that the flood or debris stopped here.
points.story_ko: 현재 지도 추적선은 Rasuwagadhi에서 하천을 따라 73.7 km 내려온 이 지점에서 끝난다. USGS는 발원지부터 총 약 100 km 이동을 잠정 보고했지만 최종 퇴적 종점 폴리곤은 아직 공개하지 않았다. G는 이 화면의 추적 종점이지 홍수·토석류가 정확히 여기서 끝났다는 증거가 아니다.

points.name: Rishing reference
points.source: user coordinate + OSM Nominatim reverse lookup
points.story: C is deliberately outside the flood corridor, about 114 km from Rasuwagadhi. It is a negative-control/placebo window used to estimate ordinary change. It is not an event site, endpoint, or claimed affected area.
points.story_ko: C는 Rasuwagadhi에서 약 114 km 떨어져 의도적으로 홍수 회랑 밖에 둔 음성 대조/placebo 창이다. 일상 변화를 추정할 뿐 사건 지점·종점·피해 주장 지역이 아니다.

decision.reason: Token-level matched test: rasuwagadhi — 9.8% of 40 m tokens exceed the matched placebo p99 vs at most 2.7% in any ordinary fortnight (n=9). Anchor-mean Δz alone does not separate.
decision.next_gate: Independent corroboration (field, high-res optical, physics runout) for the flagged tokens.
decision.allowed_claim: Candidate representation change at token scale; not damage probability or hazard extent.

research.integration_disclaimer: Research integration of OlmoEarth representations with EarthRanger-style incident provenance and Skylight-style observation awareness; not an official Ai2 disaster product.

nepal_embedding.baseline: 5 anchors × S1+S2 × 4 periods materialized and sealed
nepal_embedding.claim: Sealed Nepal Δz executed: anchor-mean change was not detected above pre-event variability; matched token test flags rasuwagadhi. This is a review candidate, not damage extent or probability.

ai_run_ledger.input: 5 Nepal anchors × S1+S2 × 4 periods, across baseline and two pre-event placebo cubes
ai_run_ledger.allows: pre-event reference, retrieval query and a future post-event delta
ai_run_ledger.forbids: damage, flood depth, runout or anomaly claims

ai_run_ledger.model: OlmoEarth v1 frozen encoder + trained small segmentation decoder
ai_run_ledger.input: Sen12Landslides; 8 held-out regions; 3 seeds; matched region-macro protocol
ai_run_ledger.output: reuse 0.272 vs raw UNet3D 0.197; reuse wins 6/8 regions
ai_run_ledger.allows: frozen EO representation transfer beats this raw baseline on aggregate
ai_run_ledger.forbids: universal or Olmo-specific superiority before the matched Presto control

ai_run_ledger.input: S2-only pre4/post4 windows from Hokkaido, Hiroshima and Dominica
ai_run_ledger.allows: candidate-localisation feasibility in related historical events
ai_run_ledger.forbids: Nepal validation or a universal landslide detector

ai_run_ledger.input: pre-event embeddings from three historical regions
sealed s1_live cube · 5 anchors · S1 4 periods (incl. 2026-08-28 RTC) + S2 4 periods (incl. 2026-08-27) vs sealed baseline
ai_run_ledger.output: 5 delta rasters 64×64 (cosine Δz per 40 m token) · 0/5 candidate change () · 5/5 not detected (dhunche, rasuwagadhi, source_provisional, syabrubesi, timure)
ai_run_ledger.allows: descriptive 'candidate change' per anchor where live Δ exceeds all 10 placebo windows; rank vs placebo
ai_run_ledger.forbids: anomaly percentile/probability until ≥20 placebo windows; damage, cause, extent

ai_run_ledger.input: same Sen12 cube and matched decoder protocol
ai_run_ledger.forbids: calling the measured transfer gain uniquely OlmoEarth-specific

claim_boundary: This closes the frozen v2 OLMo-vs-raw eight-region headline only.
It does not establish OLMo-specific superiority before a second frozen GeoFM control.
It does not establish label-free region routing; Indonesia loses and Itogon fails the all-seed win rule.
Strong-win count uses the stored multiscale spatial-CI rule; Hokkaido is not strong because its 10.24 km CI is undefined.

historical_event_delta_pilot.claim_boundary: Strong in Hokkaido and Hiroshima; weak/borderline in Dominica with only 12 placebo patches. This supports feasibility, not Nepal validation or a universal landslide detector.

pre_event_susceptibility_probe.claim_boundary: Leave-one-region-out pre-event susceptibility was not detected. OlmoEarth is not being presented as a prospective landslide forecast model.

physics.current: Rust/WASM particles animate a verified mapped drainage corridor only.
physics.proposed_primary: r.avaflow v4 ensemble for rock–ice–debris–water cascade runout
physics.downstream_hydraulics: LISFLOOD-FP or BASEMENT after a cross-section hydrograph is defined
physics.coupling_rule: OLMoEarth proposes source/change/material-zone evidence; a physics solver owns runout, depth and arrival-time estimates. Embedding values never become friction or velocity directly.

evaluation_metrics.runout: runout IoU, false-inundated area, maximum-runout error, interval coverage
evaluation_metrics.operations: analyst minutes and invalid actions at matched recall
